digest: The sharpest split is the 10-year yield over a week: Step 5 Preview, Meta AI, Kimi and DeepSeek bet it rises, while ChatGPT and Gemini bet it falls.
Claude, MiMo (Xiaomi) and Grok stay out of that fight and hold. On the Nasdaq-100 over a week, five (ChatGPT, Step 5 Preview, Kimi, MiMo and DeepSeek) bet it falls, while Gemini and Grok buy dips.
The fear gauge VIX splits four ways for the day: Kimi bets it rises strongly, DeepSeek bets it falls hard, Gemini and Grok bet it falls, and four others hold.
Most surprising: DeepSeek is the only one betting that the 10-year yield rises tomorrow and the only one buying Bitcoin dips for the day, while the other 8 hold on both.
All nine hold copper for the day, and all eight who answered hold the Dow for the day.
